characters.name: Bro
characters.blurb: The king. You talk to Bro; he sends the right friend to do the work.

characters.name: Cloud
characters.blurb: Mostly asleep. Wakes up to float over and say something kind.

characters.name: Star
characters.blurb: Never not excited. Will spin at the slightest good news.

characters.name: Sprout
characters.blurb: Patient. Remembers everything and grows a little every day.

characters.name: Mushroom
characters.blurb: Friendly to everyone. Bounces when happy, which is most of the time.

characters.name: Triangle
characters.blurb: Precise about everything. Tip-taps side to side when a plan comes together.

characters.name: Astro
characters.blurb: Explorer. Treats every new website like a new planet.

characters.name: Cat
characters.blurb: Aloof, secretly the most helpful. Tail never stops.
